title: K-th Smallest in Lexicographical Order
description: Find the k-th smallest lexicographical integer in the range [1, n].
pseudocode:
1. curr = 1, k = k - 1
2. while k > 0:
3.   steps = countSteps(n, curr, curr + 1)
4.   if steps <= k:
5.     curr++, k -= steps
6.   else:
7.     curr *= 10, k -= 1

steps.note: Initialize current pointer to 1 and decrement k.
Count numbers between 1 and 2 in the range [1, 13].
Steps (10) > k (4), so we go deeper into the current prefix.
Count nodes under 10. Only 10 itself fits in range [1, 13].
Steps (1) <= k (3), jump to next sibling.
